title: usine40 telemetry payload, version 1
description: One sample of one signal. The station and the signal are the last two levels of the MQTT topic.

session.description: Identifier of one run of the gateway process.

seq.description: Increases by one per message within a session.

source_us.description: PLC source timestamp, microseconds since the Unix epoch.

gateway_us.description: Gateway publish time, microseconds since the Unix epoch.

value.description: Signal value. States and counters are sent as numbers.

replay.description: True when the sample was re-read from the OPC UA history.
